anchors.reason: The paper describes the BrainQuake open-source toolbox for SEEG analysis. The dataset is only its example data, so the paper is a software tool paper and not this dataset's data descriptor.

anchors.paper_title: SEEG, MRI, CT for BrainQuake analysis
anchors.paper_venue: Zenodo (CERN European Organization for Nuclear Research)
anchors.reason: Earlier Zenodo deposit (5494990) "SEEG, MRI, CT for BrainQuake analysis" holds 5 of these patients with identical ictal EDF files (same MD5), so it is another deposit of the same data.

metadata.methods_description: SEEG depth electrode recordings were acquired at 2000 Hz during about two weeks of pre-surgical monitoring. Ictal clips (71 s) and interictal segments were exported as EDF/EDF+D files. MRI was acquired before and CT after electrode implantation. Interictal EDF+ annotations are listed in the events files. The BIDS conversion involved no signal processing.
